brief:
Israeli occupation forces took control of a three-story residential building in Yabad and expelled two families from the property, Shehab Wire reported. The operation resulted in the immediate displacement of households from the confiscated structure.

The seizure adds to a pattern of home confiscations affecting Palestinian communities in the occupied West Bank. Yabad, located in Jenin governorate, has faced repeated military operations and property takeovers. The forced displacement of the two families from the three-story building marks another instance of Palestinians losing access to their residences through military action.
